rows.remains: Nothing in DECIDE reads the finding (advisory). The deep brain's startup registry coverage (brains::standard) is still derived from roster manifests; the per-cycle reported-scope record and qip_organisation_scope_covered gauge are the 'what reported' coverage, and no alert policy reads that gauge (workload_metrics_exist is false, nothing scrapes). Edits to existing tests, none weakened: kernel.rs the_agent_roster_validates_at_assembly now counts the late phase too; organisation.rs organisation_without also removes late agents. dispatch() still runs late agents after the arbiters for callers with no derivation (their symbolic finding is the old no-data/stale shape); only the kernel's cycle uses the split. check-dependencies.sh not run (no dependency added).

Clause 'compiled predicates execute deterministically' needs a signed-package loader on the edge/kernel pass AND an installed PackageSigner in the deep brain (key material / trust root = credential, REASON-10099/7203). Not built; no slice.

If so SensedRecord::Tick arm must be removed/routed and Tick added to the cognitive_no_raw_ticks refused list; tick-desk fusion boundary pin and MarketStatePack consumer also undecided. Not built.
